meta.generator: .omo/ffl12 (ffl11/ffl4 engine copy; full-library scan + PU5/PU6 replay)

semantics.PU1: mov/lea ecx, X (X=reg with def[X]=P:fn:k, or direct [arg] slot load), followed within <=4 instrs by a DIRECT call target T (o_near/o_far; indirect calls produce no event; thunk followed one level); any intervening write to ecx (incl. push ecx) cancels. => edge (P:fn:k -> T:callee): parameter passed as this (value-domain propagation, strict).
semantics.PU2: movzx/movsx byte|word, FPU dword|qword, or partial-register (8/16-bit dest) mov accessing [paramReg+off], off!=0, def[paramReg]=P:fn:k => PP:fn:k:off granularity evidence (ffl8 mechanism, P-base). v2: full-library (v1 scanned the 3117-fn occupant target set only).
semantics.PU3: mov [this+off], paramReg with def[paramReg]=P:fn:k, base is this alias (als) or def=T:fn => edge (P:fn:k -> M:fn:this:off) (value-domain propagation, strict).
semantics.PU5: param cached to a frame slot (mov [slot], reg with def[reg]=P:fn:k, self-stores excluded) — store-site documentation; downstream consumption through the cache is guaranteed by engine mem forwarding (ffl3 slot penetration) and attributed via the 'via' register-tracking (counts below). Diagnostic only; no anchor section.
semantics.PU6: mov R2, [R1] (offset 0, def[R1]=P:fn:k, no arithmetic write to R1 in the previous <=5 block instructions — MI-adjustor guard) followed by call [R2+N] (N%4==0, slot=N/4; intervening full write to R2 cancels; no time window — value-survival semantics, callee-saved regs may stay armed across instructions). => P:fn:k is an object pointer dispatched through vtable slot N => domain(P:fn:k) subset of occupant family of slot N (OT semantics applied to a parameter). Form B (mov R3,[R2+N]; call R3) probed 0 occurrences library-wide — not implemented.
semantics.k_convention: P:fn:k k = stack-arg index (this excluded), identical to slot_param_groups GS k. IDA arg_N naming: k=N/4 (probe-verified).
semantics.param_gate_v2: events fire only for (fn,k) in PS-v2 = static PS (ffl11 param_pairs: GS-group pairs union minclass_assignments P entities, 4866 pairs) UNION dynamic arg_N-named pairs collected per function (11018 pairs; IDA frame analysis naming, reliable). Numeric [ebp+N] param spellings remain gated by the STATIC set only, plus an ebp-repoint guard: once 'mov/lea ebp, ...' executes, numeric ebp param resolution dies (0x44D880 fictional-param lesson).
semantics.engine_extension: slot_ent extended (ffl11 forms kept) + via register-tracking (def passed through a stack-slot forward) for cache-penetration attribution.

meta.limitations: PU6 secondary-table (MI) dispatches on unadjusted param pointers are counted as main-table slot N — secondary tables index differently; consumer must intersect with main-table families only (occupant_this_types semantics already excludes secondary tables). Partial-register writes to armed vptr regs are not tracked as kills (inherited v1 blindness, rare). Numeric [esp+N] spellings never resolve to P entities (esp varies with pushes). PU5 events are diagnostic only.
